scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
